fact: An NSDS IV orientation workshop was held on Tuesday 5 May 2026, following ZimStat's renewed efforts to develop the fourth National Strategy for the Development of Statistics for 2026-2030.
The DFDI Technical Working Group meeting in Harare is described as held amid the implementation of NSDS IV; no period or adoption date is given, so the article's published date is used.
ZIMSTAT's page lists NSDS III (2021-2025) as the successor to NSDS II (2016-2020) and NSDS I (2010-2015); no adoption date is given, so the page's published date is used.

The document presents NSDS III 2021-2025 as a final text that the ZIMSTAT Board 'presents for adoption' as the national framework for planning, budgeting and implementing statistical activities; it does not state that it has been adopted, and gives no adoption date (as_of is the document's published date).
